findings.title: Session token compared with == , allowing type coercion bypass
findings.detail: The new branch compares the supplied token to the stored one with ==, so a crafted non-string value coerces to equal.

findings.title: Expired sessions are refreshed instead of rejected
findings.detail: refresh() is called before the expiry check, so an expired session is silently extended.

findings.title: console.log left in the diff
findings.detail: Debug logging. The linter already flags this.

findings.title: Unbounded retry loop on 5xx
findings.detail: Retries without a cap; a persistent 5xx spins forever.

findings.title: Variable shadows an outer binding
findings.detail: Pre-existing on a line the diff did not modify.
